commands.observed: pooled worst p95 = 0.1907 -> epsilon 0.38; signed value kept at the conservative maximum 0.57 (see R2-02 note); trajectory request 0.6241s vs budget 0.6, cleanup subcall 0.453s, cleanup phase wall 0.8993s
commands.estimator_note: R2-02: the estimator changed between signings - v1 took max(session p95) (=0.283 -> 0.57), v2 pools the raw samples (=0.1907 -> 0.38); under the v1 reading the v2 data would give 0.2306 -> 0.46. The signed 0.57 is the maximum of all three readings, so no reading can be mistaken for a loosening, and no further loosening is allowed.
